name: Jeroboam
bio: Jeroboam, son of Jehoash (Joash), began to reign in Samaria in Amaziah's fifteenth year as king of Judah and reigned forty-one years — a later king of Israel bearing the same name as Jeroboam son of Nebat, Israel's first king. Like his namesake, he did evil in the LORD's eyes and never departed from Jeroboam son of Nebat's sins (2 Kings 14:23-24). He restored Israel's border from Lebo Hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, fulfilling the LORD's word spoken through the prophet Jonah son of Amittai of Gath Hepher, because the LORD saw Israel's bitter affliction and chose to save them by Jeroboam's hand rather than blot out Israel's name entirely. He recovered Damascus and Hamath for Israel from Judah's control (2 Kings 14:25-28). His son Zachariah succeeded him (2 Kings 14:29).
